caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular rug or textile design with a central image of a sitting cat facing forward. The cat is light beige with faint, wavy lines indicating its fur, and it has a simple face with pink eyes, nose, and mouth. Surrounding the cat are four large, stylized leaf or feather shapes—two are yellow with brown and black details, and two are pink with dark burgundy and yellow accents. The background features swirling, undulating patterns in various shades of dark and light green with hints of blue, gray, and fuchsia, creating a textured appearance. The border of the design is outlined in a dark pink or magenta color, and outside the border is a plain beige background. In the bottom left corner, the text "scale = ½ in to 1 in" is written in black.
title: Hooked Rug
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
